dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: High-degree concave spline on the posterior margin, terminating in a sharp dorsal-posterior taper.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a narrow pixel radius at the terminal point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree linear slope relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1:1 ratio between base width and vertical height from the dorsal ridge.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large radius convexity, exhibiting a gradual slope from the blowhole region toward the rostrum.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short pixel length with a high thickness-to-length ratio, appearing stubby and integrated closely with the melon.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle (estimated 155-165 degrees) at the transition point between melon and rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple small, white linear striations present on the lateral flank; minor indentation visible on the lower third of the dorsal fin's leading edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Darkened circular pigmentation surrounding the orbital region.
